title: Kopi Shift
tagline: Some words you pour. Some words you leave out.
hook: Order typography travels into the cup; Kosong leaves a visible empty sugar space.
gesture: Drag a labelled pot, sugar box or evaporated-milk tin into a cup; stir with the spoon. Click-then-cup and keyboard equivalents.
scope: One cut-paper counter, two cups, three ingredient categories, Kopi-O Kosong and Kopi-C plus optional Kopi-O transfer; no timer.
risk: Negative-space metaphor can blur O versus Kosong; fixed laptop diorama is small on phones; cross-device board sync unverified.
recommendation: Build Word Cast Counter: protect the typography-to-ingredient pour and Kosong omission before adding voice, AI or later lessons.

title: The Tape Can Hear You
tagline: An impossible welcome tape. A very ordinary wish: lunch with a friend.
hook: Name a dish and the tray wakes. Correct yourself and the serving props rewind.
gesture: Simulated speech keys, R correction, reversible prop slider, S saves the seat.
scope: One fictional TV scene, one stall, one friend, one shared plate; setup and ending overlays.
risk: Live recognition and correction timing require venue testing; preview inputs are authored.
recommendation: The Second Take: protect the rewind and the saved-seat emotional ending.

title: Can Lah!
hook: Keep Can lah fixed; change the exchange and its typographic, musical, and social world changes.
gesture: Drag the words sideways and release to play; keyboard delivery slider and Play are equivalent.
scope: One screen, three authored situations, two takes per situation, optional abstract synth sound, no live sensing.
risk: Authored readings need local speaker review; visual/music delivery is not a model of Singlish prosody.
recommendation: Variant A: Context strings. Keep the phrase fixed and let the relationship determine the performance.

title: Table Chorus
tagline: A tissue. Two cups. A little room for someone else.
hook: Clear a shared table: cup rings become eyes and exchanged saucer taps become the smile of a keepsake portrait.
gesture: Chope one place, ask, make room, slide a cup closer and take turns tapping a saucer.
scope: One top-down table, one device, two people taking turns or one person playing both roles; deterministic SVG keepsake and optional synthetic sound.
risk: Chope etiquette varies; the trace-to-face reveal needs clear staging. Human cultural review and listening rehearsal remain outstanding.
recommendation: A place for you: explicit invitation makes object relationships social and the final portrait concrete.

title: Pocket Stage
tagline: A little light. A paper hand. A shadow with a life of its own.
hook: Open the paper hand and its shadow becomes a moth; guide it to a flower that opens in greeting.
gesture: Move the light with pointer or arrows; Space opens the hand. Camera tracking is a future optional input.
scope: One SVG paper theatre, one original hand/moth silhouette, one flower, reversible controls and an in-scene ending.
risk: Inverse light movement may need guidance; shadow geometry is stylised, and camera tracking is not implemented.
recommendation: Build The Moth & the Light variant with direct pointer/keyboard input; protect the authored transformation and greeting before optional sensing.
